On Wed, Feb 22, 2012 at 10:31 AM, Zhenjiang Lan <lan.zh...@gmail.com> wrote:

>  #               RHandler brew::brew
>  #       </Directory>
>

>
> The update is, I still cannot see the info; but actually I found that
> I can use brew now.
> when I put a file in the /brew folder, I can get it run via webpage.
>
> But now, my problem is, should I save the brew script as ".brew" or ".html"?
That's up to you. It really doesn't matter.
> If I save it as ".brew", the dataframe is printed well, but no picture;

That's because apache cannot determine the mime type of a .brew file,
so it doesn't set the content type appropriately. In your Directory
stanza above, add:

DefaultType text/html

and that should fix it.
> If I save it as ".html", the dataframe is printed abnormally.

In this case apache is now setting the content type to text/html since
it knows file names ending in .html contain html markup. Your
dataframe is not printing out how you expect because text in html is
not using a proportional font. You'll want to surround the output with
<pre> tags possible to make it look better.
> And how can I get the graph print out?
What does your error log say?
